notes.title: Once Upon a Jester works great on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
The misadventures of Jester and Sok are now perfectly playable and very much enjoyable on Steam Deck and Steam compatible devices!

That's right! Now you can grab Once Upon a Jester, stick 'em in your pocket and create mischief together while commuting, doing garden work or on long, remote hikes. The possibilities are endless!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40785394/4a5837f897d0907a918aec6773b85086a6ef8cee.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Works in smooth 60fps in "High" graphics preset.
[*] Uses xbox glyphs, so we're good and there's no confusion about pressing the triangle button
[*] Controls work just fine
[*] UI scaling? You're damn right 
[*] Runs in default 720p 
[/list]

Also, follow us on:

notes.title: Sun's shining and our games are on huge discounts. Yep, must be the Summer Sale!
notes.content:
It's that time of the year again, where Lord Gaben (long may He reign) blesses us with discounts and sales. 

To make it easier for everyone to find great games worth their hard-earned money, we're throwing our titles into the ring!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34046344/2db2e49c791d9f436cef4e8d389847bb0b87b90d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Want to tease your brain and solve some puzzles? [b]MouseCraft is for you![/b]
[*] Feel like doing some wacky construction in space with your friends? [b]Bonkies is perfect![/b]
[*] Your funny bone requires tickling? [b]Once Upon a Jester will do just that![/b]
[*] Want to shoot spears made of pure light at weird creatures? [b]Lichtspeer's got your back![/b]
[/list]

See? [u]There's something for everyone![/u]

And while you're here, you can also check out our upcoming titles:

[b]Techno Banter[/b] - an adventure game about being a bouncer guarding the entrance to a techno club. If you think you've got wits and humour to chase the unwanted guests away, test your mettle here!

[b]The Gap[/b] - a serious, narrative story about a man fighting to save his own sanity and his family, while delving ever deeper into his past.

If those games pique your interest, it would mean a lot to us if you wishlisted!

Have a great Summer Sale, and may Lord Gaben have mercy on our wallets.

notes.title: Once Upon a Jester is out now!
notes.content:
We've been keeping this under wraps for a while now, but that's right - 

[h1]ONCE UPON A JESTER IS FINALLY OUT RIGHT NOW!!1[/h1]

It's available on both Steam and Nintendo Switch. In fact, it was just showcased during the [b]Nintendo Indie World![/b]

You can see our amazing launch trailer in all its glory here:
[previewyoutube=KujC1QbTh9A;full][/previewyoutube]

And, to make the launch even more exciting, we've also announced that two beloved streamers - Karl Jacobs and Foolish Gamers voice characters you can meet in Once Upon a Jester!

Geez, what a day, huh?

Anyway, hope you enjoy the game! You can always let us know how you like it on our socials <3
